newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-1860 MUNICH 3 BAYERN MUNICH 3 - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-1860 MUNICH 3 BAYERN MUNICH 3 - RESULT.

text.p: 1860 Munich and Bayern Munich drew 3-3 (halftime 2-1) in a Bundesliga match in the Olympic Stadium on Sunday.
Bayern - Juergen Klinsmann 45, Mehmet Scholl 59, Carsten Jancker 88
Red Cards: Christian Ziege (B) 71, Lothar Matthaeus (B) 84
